notes.title: Toads of the Bayou - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The wait is over, brave Toads! 🐸

[b]Toads of the Bayou[/b] is officially [b]OUT NOW[/b], and your journey into the cursed bayou begins today!

[h2]Special Launch Offer![/h2]
For its launch week, [b]Toads of the Bayou[/b] is available at [b]£7.99/$9.99/€9.99[/b] with a [b]10% discount[/b] for the first week! Don’t miss this chance to lead your toads to victory at a reduced price.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/10c4193fede6fd78bc493ad3587c97e526debdbf.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/10c4193fede6fd78bc493ad3587c97e526debdbf.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Lead the Fight Against Baron Samedi[/h2]
Baron Samedi has tricked your group of wandering toads into the cursed bayou. Now, it’s up to you to band together, build your settlement, and fight off waves of the Baron’s sinister minions. With a unique mix of turn-based tactics and roguelike deckbuilding, every decision you make will determine whether your toads thrive or succumb to the darkness.

[h2]What Awaits You in the Bayou[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/a04cb9369138b61b561ce2ad8818e55028c359d4.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/a04cb9369138b61b561ce2ad8818e55028c359d4.gif[/img][/url]
[list]
[*] [b]The Tavern - Your Strategic Hub[/b]: Upgrade and restore the Tavern to unlock access to powerful tools that will help you thrive in the bayou. Purchase traps for strategic combat, powerful cards to bolster your deck, Veves to harness vodou powers, and enlist up to unique support toads to aid you on your adventure. Invest in the Tavern itself to improve your options, unlocking even better resources to take on Baron Samedi's forces.

[*] [b]Iconic Characters[/b]: Play as one of three iconic characters, each with their own traits, bonuses, and weaknesses, in addition to 20 additional support toads who will aid your journey!

[*] [b]Deckbuilding Depth[/b]: Combine tactical movement cards with combat cards to create powerful synergies and overcome Baron Samedi’s forces.

[*] [b]Ever-Changing Challenges[/b]: Explore unique maps, face off against 10 powerful bosses, and experience the stakes of permadeath in every run.

[*] [b]Original Soundtrack[/b]: Immerse yourself in the hauntingly beautiful melodies of the cursed bayou.[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/be2d49f341458753633efe7e29e4d0879474e400.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/be2d49f341458753633efe7e29e4d0879474e400.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Watch the Launch Trailer[/h2]
Check out our launch trailer below!
[previewyoutube=ZvdrvXEOKj4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Share Your Adventure[/h2]
We’d love to see your journey through the cursed bayou! Share your screenshots, videos, and stories with us here on Steam, on social media and [url=https://discord.gg/pHKfh5BJZG]Discord[/url] too. Your feedback and experiences mean the world to us, and we can’t wait to hear how you’re faring against Baron Samedi.

[h2]Start Your Journey Today[/h2]
The time has come to lead your toads to victory! Download [b]Toads of the Bayou[/b] now and embark on your battle to thrive in the cursed bayou.

Thank you for your support and for joining us on this adventure. We’ll see you in the bayou!

notes.title: Toads of the Bayou - October Playtest & Development Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, brave Toads!

We’re excited to share some important updates regarding the development of [b]Toads of the Bayou.[/b] 

Over the past months, we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes on the game. However, [b]we have made the decision to disable the prologue[/b].

[b][h3]Shifting Focus to the Main Game[/h3][/b]

Although the prologue was originally intended to give you an early taste of what’s to come, after much consideration we have decided to pivot away from releasing the prologue and instead focus all of our energy on delivering the complete version of Toads of the Bayou. 

This shift allows us to dedicate our full attention to refining the core game play, enhancing the roguelike deckbuilding mechanics, and creating a deeper, more polished experience. The cursed bayou, Baron Samedi’s tricks, and the intense strategic battles are being brought to life in a way that will be worth the wait.

[b][h3]Play the latest build of Toads of the Bayou![/h3][/b]

Want to see what we've been working on and get hands-on with some toady mayhem? Our closed playtest is coming 8th October and we'd love for you to take part! 

To claim your key, all you need to do is [url=https://discord.gg/ZHrJaqHwey][b]join us on Discord[/b][/url] and you'll be assigned a role. We'll be giving out the keys on Tuesday so please join before then. 

[b][h3]Sneak Peek: New Screenshots and GIFs[/h3][/b]

We’re thrilled to share new images and GIFs from the latest build of the game! These showcase our progress, including updated environments, combat animations, and synergies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/76e24ba13cba5609c97d045744ce1849596ae22b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/b823066a3aa9c9904bcc483e781c75594618b97e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/c712f49461e5ed1b906c3c8aed3f62b1997dcb4e.gif[/img]

Make sure to follow us for regular updates, as we’ll be revealing more content in the coming months.

[h3]A slight change in our release date[/h3]

With all the exciting new changes coming to Toads of the Bayou, we just need a little longer to cook. Our game will no longer be releasing in October, but we're not far off now - Toads of the Bayou will be coming very soon! 

Thank you for your understanding and continued support. We’re fully committed to delivering the best possible version of Toads of the Bayou, and we can’t wait to share the full adventure with you soon.

Stay tuned for more updates, and don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam!

La Grange 🐸

notes.title: Dev Log #3: What's new & SimFest
notes.content:
Hey toads 🐸

It’s been a while since the last dev log, and boy did we go over some upgrades! A lot of work has been put into the game since we last gave an update, and I’m super excited to share it with you.

[h3][b]Recruits:[/b][/h3]
One of the major additions to the game is the ability to [b]recruit toads directly from the Tavern[/b], to join you in your uprising journey against Baron Samedi! We have imagined a lot of unique toads, which all have their own special abilities, to help you create the best combos you can think of. As your progress through your run, your toads will be your best allies against the creatures from the Bayou.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/2e2806b77e4d4f7c80d84c6c7094e4bbca1875cd.gif[/img]

Recruits behave as activated abilities, that trigger when a certain condition is met. The good thing is that there is not activation limit! You’ll see their icon pop on the screen when they get triggered, and this will surely mean that you did something good!

[h3][b]Tavern:[/b][/h3]
About that Tavern I mentioned…we gave it a nice upgrade as well. After all, it’s not just your hub, it’s the rebellion’s headquarters! Navigate through the rooms, take a deep breath and smell that gumbo cooking in the back while you shop for Bear Traps and Poisonous Bullets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/51e290abf2206ca5a511d8ca2ddd6be1ed8de78d.gif[/img]

We designed the Tavern as the [b]perfect hideout for your band[/b], in which you can plan your next sabotage operation while sipping a good old cup of Moonshine with the toads. [b]Each of the Tavern’s room has its own unique atmosphere[/b], inspired by its purpose. The traps room, for example, feels like a hunting cabin, while the veves room is definitely the most mystical place you’ll visit!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/591274769bd79d89eb96ef7d23c9f3e64f2156e7.gif[/img]

We wanted this place to feel like home, in this wasteland that your beloved Bayou has become since Samedi arrived. Nobody could really tell where the Tavern is located, and the supplies are not always guaranteed, but one thing is for sure : it will always feel good to be back at the Tavern after a fight. And this is what you’re fighting for!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/00ce7fbdc370b80345bcd9be46bae0441e2463cd.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Balancing, game rhythm, and more:[/b][/h3]
Game feel has been one of the top priorities working on Toads of the Bayou. One of the most difficult things to balance is Movement, as this plays a major role in how the grid-based gameplay feels. The initial formula was to offer a Movement Deck alongside the Combat Deck, guarantying players to draw at least 1 movement card per turn. To balance the ability to Attack and Move in the same turn, [b]we introduced the Timed keyword[/b], which makes cards go up in cost as other cards are played before them. But this sometimes led to frustrating situations, where attacking would totally jeopardize the ability to re-position during the turn, forcing players to prioritize avoiding danger instead of fighting back.

We got rid of the Movement Deck, and decided to offer more options to Move, in connection with other aspects of the game, such as the Recruits, the items, and more. [b]This allows more organic synergies[/b], and helps players take care of the enemies without having to worry about making a mistake.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/e2d5c37ca819a9d4a19ccf3e862a354c710791c1.gif[/img]

And…this is all I wanted to cover in this dev log! We have a [url=https://discord.gg/ZHrJaqHwey][b]Discord server[/b][/url], which you can join to follow the latest news on the game! 

In other exciting news, we're part of [b]SimFest[/b] from now until July 29th, and there's loads of awesome simulation games to discover! Check out the full selection of titles [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/simfest2024]here[/url][/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/a1129d629ba28c05bd232da9947bf6d12623e10c.gif[/img]

We'll continue sharing updates as often as we can, and again, we would like to thank all of you for supporting the game and following its development. Your feedback and comments are super precious to us in this adventure!

Until next time!

notes.title: Gamescom & Demo Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Hey everybody,

Just a quick note to say that we're taking our gun-wielding toads to Gamescom 2023! We're really excited to be attending, and we've got some toady goodies to give away too. 

[h3]Find us at the Indie Arena Booth[/h3]

If you're at the event, do stop by and say hello! You can grab some [b]physical art cards[/b] and an [b]A4 print of our new prologue art[/b], PLUS you can check out our [b]updated demo[/b] and have a jolly good time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/97d02aed7a2f108a7ed1dc2984a7e2cc9c20943d.gif[/img]

[h3]Everyone can Play our Demo![/h3]

Not going to Gamescom? No worries, [i]ba-you[/i] can still play our demo from home! With a few updates added, the demo is ready to download & enjoy. 

Thanks so much to everyone who has played our game so far and wishlisted, we can't wait to show you more very soon... 

[h3]Demo Patch Notes[/h3]

[b]UI/UX :[/b]
  
[list]
[*] Added a victory screen at the end of combat, displaying XP and loots
[*] Added icons for Strength and Accuracy alongside Statuses icons
[*] New responsive tooltips
[*] Better selection for objects on the map
[*] Recursive tooltips (keywords in one's description create their own tooltip under the main one)
[*] Changed health bar to display unit's health amount. The colour is also slightly lighter
[/list]
[b]Enemies:[/b]
  
[list]
[*] Noise Monster's animation is not playing multiple times anymore
[*] Better sequencing during enemies turns
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
  
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where broken barrels still blocked their position
[*] New animations (casting, healing, accuracy buff, strength buff)
[/list]

Until next time!

The La Grange Team

notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Since the playtest started, we put a lot of effort into applying your feedback, and we are really happy to share a new patch for the game! 

Our main focus was of course the UI/UX, since this was one of the most frequent points in your feedback. We took a lot of time re-thinking how the game should feel, and how to make the navigation easier based on your suggestions. 


🎮[b]UI/UX:[/b]

[list]
[*]When playing a card, you can now directly target the cell where you want to apply the effect
[*]Buildings, trees, and props will now become 35% transparent when hiding a unit. Unit's silhouette opacity have been reduced to 15%, in order to subtly highlight the unit without compromising the battlefield readability
[*]In the Combat Phase, card tooltips are now displayed next to the card
[*]Card tooltips are now displayed in buildings and in the deck window
[*]Card effect text is now updated with the toad's current stats
[*]Hovering over a building in the Management Phase will display an icon (currently placeholder) to show that you can buy cards
[/list]

We have also started integrating some of your feedback in terms of game design and balancing. 

📯[b]Game Design/Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*]Burn now works with counters. An enemy will apply X [i]Burn Counter[/i] to its target. 1* Burn Counter* is removed at the beginning of the turn, or anytime a card is played, the latter dealing 1 damage
[*]Introduction of the [i]Extinguish[/i] mechanic - some card effects reduce Burn Counters
[*]Toads do not have a "movement range" stat anymore. Movement is based on cards effects, and on buffs.
[*][i]Stabbing[/i] buff is now called [i]Strength[/i], and [i]Shooting[/i] buff is now called [i]Accuracy[/i]
[*]Most of the card effects have been reworked to create more engaging combat situations
[*]Building passives have been removed
[*]Buildings will now only offer 3 cards. The player will have to place another building of the same type to buy more cards from it
[*]Buildings will now offer 3 random cards, selected from their own card pool
[/list]

And last but not least... [b]new trees![/b] 🔥🌳

Thank you so much to all of you. Once again, your feedback and suggestions are the key for us to make Toads of the Bayou the best we can, and it is an absolute thrill to see you all play the game and to hear your great ideas about the game in its current state. The playtest is still LIVE until 5th July, don't miss out on your chance to play and give us your thoughts  🐸❤️

You can join through our Discord and by following the instruction in the Announcement channel: discord.gg/JG9rgyXATM

The La Grange Team.
